# excon v4.1.0 - Table of Contents

> PNG/SVG identicons in pure Elixir.

## Modules

- [Excon](https://excon.hexdocs.pm/Excon.md): Pure Elixir identicon creator
- [Excon.ImageMaker](https://excon.hexdocs.pm/Excon.ImageMaker.md):   Behaviour for creating images from a hash.

- [Excon.ImageMaker.Duotone](https://excon.hexdocs.pm/Excon.ImageMaker.Duotone.md): The :duotone interface for ExCon.
- [Excon.ImageMaker.Framed](https://excon.hexdocs.pm/Excon.ImageMaker.Framed.md): The :framed interface for ExCon.
- [Excon.ImageMaker.Png](https://excon.hexdocs.pm/Excon.ImageMaker.Png.md): The :png interface for ExCon.
- [Excon.ImageMaker.Svg](https://excon.hexdocs.pm/Excon.ImageMaker.Svg.md): The :svg interface for ExCon.
- [Excon.PNGUtils](https://excon.hexdocs.pm/Excon.PNGUtils.md): Utility functions for ExCon PNG image processing.

- [Excon.Palettes](https://excon.hexdocs.pm/Excon.Palettes.md): Some predefined palettes for ExCon.
